purpose: Extend already useful natural airtime into an upgrade-to-upgrade bridge.
risk: Fuel adds little when the normal jump is still too short to approach another useful event.
description: Jump Height creates a longer runway and Rocket Fuel extends it after the normal arc would begin to fall.
prerequisites: Enough natural height to clear several loops

purpose: Combine a direct movement foundation with the progression card used by community routes.
risk: Luck has no published formula, so the progression benefit cannot be expressed as a percentage.
description: Multiple successful community routes prioritize both cards early, then use the extra airtime to benefit from faster progression when it appears.
prerequisites: Immediate rope safety is not already failing

purpose: Protect the rope pressure added for score volume or a multi-rope challenge.
risk: Adding ropes before protection and readable airtime can still make the setup collapse.
description: Reinforcement addresses the maintenance cost created by a larger active rope set.
prerequisites: The existing rope pattern is readable
Movement is stable enough to support another rope

purpose: Turn a stable multi-rope engine into a higher-pressure score route.
risk: Both cards increase rope maintenance pressure and are poor additions to an unstable opening.
description: The combination supports late scoring, but only after height, fuel and protection can absorb the extra failure points.

purpose: Support community routes that try to reach another upgrade before fuel expires.
risk: The refill-on-upgrade interaction and Luck formula are player reports, not official guarantees.
description: Luck is used as a progression foundation while Rocket Fuel bridges the remaining airtime toward the next selection.
prerequisites: Visible progression is fast enough to approach another level-up
Fuel behavior has been checked on the current run

purpose: Increase late-run loop volume only after the run can read and protect a larger pattern.
risk: Changing rope count and timing together compresses reactions and makes it harder to identify why a miss occurred.
description: The pair can serve a mature score engine, but taking both during the opening is a common way to lose control.
prerequisites: Several loops already fit in one jump
The active rope set is reinforced
